claims.claim: Industrial electric sewing machine is use for sewing of clothes and multi-purpose uses.
claims.evidence: Witness only reports photos of sewing machines; no proof of industrial capability or multi-purpose use.
Witness report shows brand/model markings (BICCA, Singer, SENCO Indigo 6, NOVAMATIC NM 868A) but no clear “Japanese made” marking captured.
No video/test of running motor, speed, or sound is shown in the witness observations.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual are included.
claims.evidence: Witness notes accessories/manual not shown; photos do not confirm inclusion.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No service history or internal inspection is shown.

risks.risk: Unclear exact machine identity: witness report shows multiple different brand/model markings across photos (BICCA, Singer, SENCO Indigo 6, NOVAMATIC NM 868A), which could mean different machines or mismatched labels.
risks.proof: A single photo showing the full model/brand plate clearly on one machine (front + side + base label), with the same machine in all angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-confidence option (generic used electric sewing machine) and treat as potentially not matching the claimed model/brand.

risks.risk: Not confirmed working condition (motor, stitching, thread tension, feed dogs, needle/presser foot operation).
risks.proof: Short video of a full stitching test: power on, needle moving, feeding fabric, and a completed seam (with thread installed).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / as-is for repair or limited use.

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete accessories (presser feet, bobbins, needles, power cord, manual).
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing all included items laid out and counted (feet set, bobbins, needles, power cable, manual).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming accessories/manual are missing or incomplete.

risks.risk: Physical condition issues not visible in the photos (rust, cracks, worn feed dogs, bent needle bar, loose parts).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: feed dogs, needle area, presser foot, underside/base, and any visible wear points.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst cosmetic/usage wear typical for used machines.

risks.risk: Power/voltage compatibility for Lagos (whether it runs on local current; whether it needs a transformer).
risks.proof: Video of it running on Lagos power (plugged in) showing stable operation without tripping or overheating.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring verification for local power compatibility.

proof_requests: Confirm the exact brand and model on ONE machine with a clear label/plate photo (front + side + base).
Send a video of a stitching test with fabric (thread installed) showing smooth motor operation and proper feeding.
Show all accessories and the original manual laid out and counted (presser feet, bobbins, needles, power cord, manual).
Provide close-ups of feed dogs, needle/presser foot area, and underside/base for wear or damage.
Show it running when plugged into Lagos power (stable operation).
response.reason: The witness photos identify sewing machines but do not confirm which exact machine/model is being sold, and they do not verify working condition or included accessories. Without a clear single identity and a stitching/power test, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
